label: Donors and minority holes
subgoals: Set the majority electron density equal to the donor density
Divide ni squared by the donor density for the minority holes

label: Acceptors and minority electrons
subgoals: Set the majority hole density equal to the acceptor density
Divide ni squared by the acceptor density
Name which side of a junction holds more minority carriers

label: Compensated doping
subgoals: Subtract the smaller dopant density from the larger to get the net doping
Assign the region its type and its majority density
Compute the minority density from ni squared over the net doping
